message.Title: Generally Available: AKS Automatic pod readiness SLA

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Automatic clusters now come with a pod readiness SLA, guaranteeing that eligible pods meet readiness criteria within five minutes at the 99.9th percentile. This empowers customers to confidently deploy mission critical workloads, knowing that their infrastructure is reliable and comes with financial backing.  

Learn more.
